style.name: Silver Screen Soft Deco
style.blend: Quiet Luxury Contemporary + Parisian Contemporary + Contemporary Art Deco
style.definition: Dove-gray curves and reflective accents evoke old cinema in a light residential room.

style.living: dove-gray curved 205cm sofa; ivory boucle swivel chair; round pale-stone coffee table with nickel base; dark walnut media cabinet; 105cm round dark walnut table and four dove chairs; opal nickel pendant
style.bed: dove fan-shaped queen headboard; dark walnut nightstands; opal lamps; ivory quilt
style.solarium: charcoal aluminum lounge frames with gray cushions; round outdoor dining
style.implement: Use a single stepped silver mirror and a low-contrast scallop rug; keep reflections localized.
style.avoid: Avoid mirror-clad furniture and theatrical ceiling treatments.
